labeling_rule: A file is relevant to a query if a developer asked to understand or change that feature would have to open it: it either implements the named behavior or defines a step the behavior delegates to by name. A package __init__.py that only holds a docstring or re-exports a name is not relevant, because it contains nothing to read about the feature. A test of the named behavior is relevant. Labels were written from the fixture source before either system was run.

queries.rationale: routes.post_login is the entry point; service.login_user creates the session.
service.verify_password compares the submitted password; repository.find_account supplies the stored password_hash it is compared against.
calculate_invoice is the only code that totals an invoice.
find_account is the only account lookup in the repository.
post_login is the only HTTP entry point in the repository.
calculate_invoice takes the tax amount; nothing else in the repository touches tax.
InvoiceCalculator.total and default_calculator are the whole invoice calculation.
billing.TAX_RATES and InvoiceCalculator apply the rate; config.Settings.tax_rate declares it with its default.
Settings and the DEFAULT_TIMEOUT, RETRY_LIMIT, and BACKOFF_SECONDS constants are all declared here.
build_parser and main are the only argument parsing in the repository.
JsonCodec.encode and the ujson/json backend selection are the only JSON handling.
the platform-gated cache_directory is the only cache path in the repository.
login.login and login_required implement signing in; issue_token is the step login delegates to; User.check_password is the password check it calls.
tokens.verify_token implements it; login_required and place_order are its two callers, so changing it means reading them.
checkout.cart_total sums the cart; User.cart and Book.price_cents define what is summed; test_checkout asserts the behavior.
search_books filters on Book.title; models.py defines Book and that title field.
config.SECRET_KEY declares it; tokens.issue_token is its only consumer.
manage.main reads sys.argv; App.run is what it hands the arguments to.
the legacy charge function is the only payment code in the repository.
